node.name: Star_Talent_Reset_Potion
node.description: Hold down on this item to refund all your Star Talent Points! Well, except for the Star tab points, there's a different potion for... no wait, this IS the potion for that!

item:ResetFrag.name: Talent_Point_Reset_Fragment
item:ResetFrag.description: Hold down on this item to turn 10 Fragments into 1 Talent Point Reset Potion. You'll need 1 open inventory space for this to work.

item:PureWater.name: Distilled_Water
item:PureWater.description: The full filtration process also involves filtering the diamonds through a vat of diamonds before using those filtered diamonds to filter the water! If only they'd filter their filtration process through diamonds so this item description wouldn't be so long.

quest:Builder_Bird1.name: Restoring_Power_to_the_Portal
quest:Builder_Bird1.description: Defeat the Boss at the end of World 1 to retrieve the gem and open the portal to WORLD 2!!

item:ExpBalloon1.name: Small_Experience_Balloon
item:ExpBalloon1.description: Hold down to gain EXP in the skill that's displayed in the corner of your screen. If you're in a town, you will gain EXP in the town skill. The amount of EXP you get is based on your skill's Lv.

item:Crystal1.name: Desert_Topaz
item:Crystal1.description: Give this to the bird in town to unlock the portal to World 2! You can come back to World 1 whenever you want, don't worry.

item:Critter7.name: Bunny
item:Critter7.description: It could use a carrot, the lil' guy needs some food!

item:Critter7A.name: Purbunni
item:Critter7A.description: The other bunny is brilliant... But I like this one more.
